full_judgment: 18. In the case of Golam Ahmed Vs. Mohammad Ata Karim and others 9 DLR 382 a question arose whether a civil revision under Section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedures is maintainable in the High Court Division against an order passed by the authority dealing with Civil Jurisdiction under the Payment of Wages Act. A Division Bench in the said case, considered number of decisions of this Subcontinent including some Full Bench decisions and upon consideration of the said decisions, approved the views expressed in the cases of Manager, Spring Mills Vs.
